## Relationships

### [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

[Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) is the sister of Tommy, a relationship established in Volume 3. Her brother is involved in the local social circle that interacts with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), as seen when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing with the Cotton family.
